dept.en: School of Mechanical Engineering, College of Engineering, Pusan National University

address.en: Room 619, Mechanical Engineering Bldg., Pusan National University, 2 Busandaehak-ro 63beon-gil, Geumjeong-gu, Busan 46241, Korea

eyebrow.en: School of Mechanical Engineering · Pusan National University

lead.ko:
구조물을 계산으로 해석하고(Analysis), 계측과 모델로 상태를 읽어내며(Intelligence), 더 안전한 기기를 설계합니다(Design).
**전산역학**, **지능형구조**, **첨단기기개발**을 연구합니다.
lead.en:
We analyze structures by computation, read their state with measurements and models, and design safer equipment.
Our research: **computational mechanics**, **intelligent structures** and **advanced equipment development**.

title.en: Recruiting graduate students, postdocs & undergraduate researchers

body.ko: 부산대학교 기계공학부 구조해석·설계·지능 연구실(SADI)에서 **더 안전하고 가치 있는 엔지니어링**을 위한 구조 연구에 함께할 신입 대학원생(석사·박사), 박사후연구원 및 학부연구생을 모집합니다.
body.en: The Structural Analysis, Design & Intelligence Lab (SADI) at PNU Mechanical Engineering is recruiting new M.S./Ph.D. students, postdoctoral researchers and undergraduate researchers to work toward **safer, more valuable engineering**.

points.ko: 전산역학(유한요소·멀티피직스 해석), 지능형구조(가상측정·디지털 트윈), 첨단기기개발(차세대 원자로 기기 설계) 등 다양한 연구 분야
points.en: Computational mechanics (finite elements, multiphysics), intelligent structures (virtual sensing, digital twins) and advanced equipment development (next-generation reactor components)

points.ko: 국내외 학술대회 발표, 연구기관·산업체 공동연구 참여 등 함께 성장하는 연구 환경
points.en: Conference presentations at home and abroad and joint research with institutes and industry

closing.ko: 연구실에 관심 있는 학생은 메일로 연락 바랍니다.
closing.en: If you are interested, please get in touch by email.

title.en: We are looking for people to research with

body.ko: 석사·박사과정 학생, 학부연구생, 박사후연구원을 모집합니다. 구조해석, 가상측정, 기기 설계에 관심이 있다면 이메일로 연락해 주세요.
body.en: We are recruiting M.S. and Ph.D. students, undergraduate researchers and postdocs. If structural analysis, virtual sensing or equipment design interests you, send us an email.
